## Our _history_

It’s time for the kickoff where we’re sharing

**our history and initial data**.

### [01\. When did we start?](https://seowind.io/ai-writing-challenge/\#)

We’ve launched an MVP of SEOwind at the end of November 2022 (about 6 months ago). We wanted to create a SaaS tool that will help Humans with crafting article briefs based on SEO data, that will be used to create articles that nail the search intent.

### [02\. MVP](https://seowind.io/ai-writing-challenge/\#)

As the tool was really stripped down from features and was focused on essential features, users liked the concept but the tool was not bringing enough value to switch.

### [03\. The power of feedback](https://seowind.io/ai-writing-challenge/\#)

In the last 6 months we’ve met 1:1 with more than 500 people. We were prioritizing product development based on the feedback that we were getting. Thanks to delivering more value to the product we slowly could see an increase in customers month over month.

### [04\. Briefing Humans is no different than Prompting AI](https://seowind.io/ai-writing-challenge/\#)

At some point we’ve understood that Briefing Humans is no different than Prompting AI. If you want to get quality content you have to provide a proper input to AI to be able to write it. And this is exactly what we’ve done! (Lookup [CyborgMethod™ post](https://seowind.io/hack-ai-writing-with-cyborg-method/) if you want to learn more about our approach)

### [05\. Only 6-8 blog articles published per month](https://seowind.io/ai-writing-challenge/\#)

As we focused mainly on product development and getting feedback from users, we only published 6-8 blog articles per month. We were writing them using SEOwind research for creating the briefs. This worked great, even at the small scale we were publishing.

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Tom2.png)

## Kick-off _data_

SEOwind.io starting point for #100Posts30DaysChallenge

### Step 1: Topic Selection

#### **Process description:**

We focus on topics relevant to our business. SEOwind conducts content research, creates outlines and briefs, and [writes AI articles](https://seowind.io/how-to-write-articles-with-ai/) – we focus on that.

We also looked into insights from over 500 talks I had in the last few months. Quite a source of goals, needs, and pains.

**We’ve chosen to cover such topics:**

- Content strategy & writing
- Blogging
- Tools for writing, optimizing, researching
- SEO
- AI & ChatGPT

This led us to dozens of [seed keywords](https://seowind.io/seed-keyword/).

#### **Tools we use:**

Google, customer conversations ????

### Step 2: Keyword Selection

#### **Process description:**

- We conducted keyword research to identify opportunities,
- We looked at Google Search Console (GSC) for keywords with impressions but still underperforming,
- We conducted a content gap analysis to see what our competitors cover.

#### **Tools we use:**

SEOwind, Ahrefs, Semrush, GSC ????️

### Step 3: Data-Driven Content Brief Creation

#### **Process description:**

Starting with the primary keyword, we use SEOwind to conduct content research. It gives us competitive analysis, competitor outlines, questions to answer, and ranking keywords.

Our tool uses AI to create titles, meta descriptions, and AI outlines, which we treat as a strong starting point. We add to the outline our insights, tips, best practices, and our product where relevant.

We also add secondary keywords. SEOwind provides keywords that top SERPs rank in the top 30. This way, you can rank with this content for such keywords.

#### **Tools we use**:

SEOwind ⚙️

### Step 4: AI Article Writing

#### **Process description:**

We use SEOwind to write the article, with detailed prompts on context, tasks, and instructions in the background.

#### **Tools we use:**

SEOwind ????

### Step 5: Proofreading & Editing

#### **Process description:**

We carefully check content for:

- Quotes, numbers, and links (here AI makes the most mistakes)
- Brand-inconsistent expressions
- Long sentences (which we trim)
- Product descriptions

#### **Tools we use:**

Grammarly Premium ✅

### Step 6: Blog Post Optimization

#### **Process description:**

We optimize content by adding inbound and outbound links, relevant images with alt tags, and utilizing NLP and more keywords for better visibility. Our SEOwind tool is being beta-tested for content optimization.

#### **Tools we use**:

Unsplash, Depositphotos, Link Whisperer

### Step 7: Publish

#### **Process description:**

And voila! You can publish your AI-generated content.

Afterward, we request indexing the page in GSC to speed up the process.

## Day 7:  _Initial traction in growth_

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/website_pink_bird.svg)

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/violet-lines-website.svg)

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/green_lines.svg)

### 27 AI Articles Published _using CyborgMethod™_

Write content that ranks not for one keyword, but for dozens of keywords.

???? We’ve published 27 articles in the first 7 days.

On average, we publish 3,85 articles per day (counting weekends). I’m not saying it’s easy, but it’s manageable. We divided the work between 2 people (writing AI content is just a part of our everyday job).

Even though it’s very early, we already see some traction in growth.

According to GSC, we can see the following numbers Week over Week (WoW):

???? **1\. CLICKS grew by 26,6%.**

The week before, when we started the challenge, we had 357 Clicks; last week, it grew to 452 Clicks.

???? **2\. TOTAL IMPRESSIONS grew by 34,1%.**

The week before, we had 117K impressions compared to 157K impressions last week.

Higher % growth of impressions compared to clicks was expected. First, we must show up anywhere in SERP, and the clicks will follow.

![100postsin30daysChallenge Day 7](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/100postsin30daysChallenge-Day-7.jpg)
